root_cause.evidence: The CVE description explains that "when new folios are allocated without being marked uptodate and ni_read_frame() is skipped ... some reserved folios may remain only partially filled, leaving the rest memory uninitialized." The patch fixes this by adding `__GFP_ZERO` to the allocation flags in `__filemap_get_folio()`.
